caption_L1: This bar chart is named Leading mining countries worldwide in 2016 , based on mineral production value (in billion U.S. dollars). The y-axis measures Production value in billion U.S. dollars using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 600 while the x-axis plots Country on categorical scale starting with Australia and ending with United States.
caption_L2L3: China was the leading mining country in 2016, with a production value of over 600 billion US dollars. China's mineral production dwarfed each of its nearest competitors Australia, India, Russia and the US by over 6 fold.
